Added confirmable cancellation. Cancel button shows during conversion → AlertDialog (reused consent-gate primitive) → cancelConversion() calls disposeEngine (terminate() rejects in-flight exec, caught by pipeline) and resets queued/in-flight rows to 'ready' while keeping completed downloads. convertVideos gained isCancelled() guard so the batch drains without emitting spurious error rows. Next Convert re-inits engine from cache via idempotent loadEngine. cancelling flag + disposeEngine's Option.isSome guard prevent double-terminate races. tsc/biome/tests/build all green; engine+converter stay in separate chunks (bundle boundary intact).

Fixed: added server.headers + preview.headers (COOP same-origin / COEP require-corp) to vite.config.ts. src/server.ts only covers the worker/SSR handler; Vite's dev & preview middleware serve @ffmpeg/ffmpeg's worker.js?worker_file&type=module directly, so without these the nested pthreads workers couldn't spawn and ffmpeg.load() hung on 'Preparing tools'. Verified COEP now present on Vite-served assets (/@vite/client) in dev. tsc + tests green.

Confirmed working by user. Root cause was ffmpeg.wasm core-mt OOM on high-res (4K) input. Fix: lighter H.264 settings (preset veryfast + threads 2) to fit the fixed WASM memory ceiling, OOM detection that disposes the dead engine for clean re-init, and an honest user-facing message. Log capture (on/off 'log' event + tail in VideoEncodeError) surfaced the cause and stays as a permanent diagnostic.
